title: Automations and Background Agents with Event Triggers
description: Cursor now supports automations for building always-on agents that run based on schedules or event triggers from Slack, Linear, GitHub, PagerDuty, and webhooks. Agents use MCPs and models with memory tools to learn from past runs.

community_feedback.quote: Slack integration is mentioned both as a feature (MCP integration) and a security concern (vulnerability)

title: Cursor ACP Support for JetBrains IDEs
description: Cursor is now available in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs through the Agent Client Protocol (ACP). Users can install Cursor ACP directly and authenticate with existing Cursor accounts.

community_feedback.quote: Cursor joins the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) Agent Registry, allowing you to use its agent right in AI Assistant

title: MCP Apps with Interactive UIs in Agent Chats
description: MCP Apps now support interactive user interfaces like charts from Amplitude, diagrams from Figma, and whiteboards from tldraw directly inside Cursor agent chats.

title: Team Marketplaces for Plugins
description: Teams and Enterprise plan admins can create team marketplaces to share private plugins internally with central governance and access controls.

title: Bugbot Autofix for Pull Requests
description: Bugbot can automatically fix issues found in pull requests. Cloud agents test changes and propose fixes directly on PRs. Over 35% of Bugbot Autofix changes are merged into the base PR.

title: Gemini CLI v0.33.2
description: Latest stable release with Plan Mode - a new read-only mode that restricts Gemini CLI to a subset of its tools. Includes UI polish, core fixes, and new tools.

title: Control Cowork from your phone with persistent thread
description: Pro and Max plan users can access a persistent agent thread via Claude Desktop or Claude for iOS/Android to manage tasks in Cowork, extending Claude Code's agentic capabilities to mobile.

title: Claude Code v2.1.78
description: Added StopFailure hook event for API errors, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA variable for plugin persistent state, and effort/maxTurns/disallowedTools frontmatter support. Fixed numerous issues including git log failures, session history truncation, and security fixes for sandbox disable warnings.

community_feedback.quote: Looks like updating to claude code v2.1.78 drops the default Opus 4.6 1M context and goes back to...

title: Updates to GitHub Copilot for Students
description: Introduction of the new GitHub Copilot Student plan focused on building a long-term, sustainable Copilot experience tailored specifically for students with updates to GitHub Education integration.

community_feedback.quote: tl;dr - they nerf'd the options and the best models are no longer free
feels like a huge downgrade after seeing the email announcement
They're rebranding the free tier as the 'GitHub Copilot Student' plan, which is just corporate code for 'the budget version'
Discounted Pro upgrade for verified students — A 40–50% discount on GitHub Copilot Pro

title: Windsurf JetBrains Plugin v2.12.14
description: JetBrains plugin updated to version 2.12.14 with bug fixes and improvements for IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and WebStorm.

title: Codex CLI 0.114.0
description: Introduced an experimental code mode for more isolated coding workflows and added a hooks engine. Improved approval prompts and app connection sign-in flows.

title: Gemini CLI Plan Mode Announcement
description: Plan Mode is a new read-only mode that restricts Gemini CLI to a subset of its tools, announced on March 11, 2026.

title: Claude Code v2.1.77
description: Increased default max output tokens for Opus 4.6 to 64k, upper bound to 128k. Added allowRead sandbox setting and improved /copy command. Fixed auto-updater memory issues, permission rule handling, and various performance improvements.

title: Install Devin as a Progressive Web App
description: Devin can now be installed as a Progressive Web App (PWA) on both desktop and mobile devices. Users can install Devin directly from Chrome or Edge browsers for standalone app access.

title: Visual Studio February Update
description: Published in March, the February update brought expanded agent capabilities, smarter code completions, and deeper Copilot integration in Visual Studio 2026.
